name: KidsCodeAcademy
description: A safe, offline coding and math academy for children ages 7 and up.
summary: Sixty coding lessons with read-aloud practice, Math Minute, chess breaks, creative projects, and a parent dashboard.
features: Three-question guided Math Minute in every lesson, from Grade 2 foundations into early Grade 3
Rules-correct chess breaks with legal-move hints, piece lessons, grading, and history
Word Power cards that explain and read aloud important coding vocabulary
Durable local progress and project saves
